observations.html: On offering it

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Master Tallon Darkfist
"We have not always hidden in small villages and shacks outside of Tanvu. Before the Ulvari came, our school stood proud. Our students were honored and revered. But times have changed."

"The emperor refused to aid us in the battle against the Ulvari; instead, he blamed us for their incursion. We are no longer welcome."

"Hidden nearby is the Ghost Wind Academy, one of the last remaining compounds where Lao'Jin can be studied. I want you to go there and speak with the Headmaster. We are done for now."

observations.html: On finishing it

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Lao'Jin Master Yaol
Master Yaol tells you, "Very good, Psionicist. You have helped greatly in the fight against the Ra'Jin."

"We should be able to fend off the rest of the Ra'Jin, but I must now turn my concern to the safety of the students."

"I have one final task for you."
